question: For the fixed Forest10 official Test workload, compare the already-measured ALL random-01 set with the frozen Issue #99 Nominal B5 set when the relative CREATE/OID order of the five shared candidate IDs is matched.

order_matching.predeclared_primary_comparison: ALL random-01 minus B5; B5 CREATE order exactly equals the random-01 projection
order_matching.random02_role: secondary descriptive comparison only; shared-object relative priority is not matched
order_matching.order_hash_encoding: SHA-256 of M0 canonical_bytes(list(order)): UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=true, sort_keys=true, separators=(',', ':') followed by one newline

inputs_and_environment.explain_format: EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, SUMMARY OFF, ESS_DIAGNOSTICS true)

metrics.primary_delta_sign: positive means ALL random-01 has higher/worse P95 Q-error than B5
metrics.qerror: Issue #101 qerror_for_plan_rows including zero-aware handling and NumPy rounding
metrics.quantiles: Issue #101/105 NumPy 2.3.4 median/percentile behavior; compute each config separately before contrasts
metrics.query_pairing: immutable query_id plus identical source_index and true_cardinality; require matching official SQL/truth identities
metrics.paired_delta: ALL Q-error minus B5 Q-error; negative means ALL lower/better, positive means ALL higher/worse
metrics.p95_neighborhood: for each configuration, sort by (Q-error ascending, query_id ascending); report the 201 query IDs at zero-based ranks 9400 through 9600 and paired changes in the union of both rank windows
metrics.mcv_usage: per candidate ID, count queries with at least one mcv_selection and at least one mcv_estimate event; separately count queries using any candidate outside the frozen B5 set in ALL
metrics.inferential_claims: one fixed-workload matched-priority set contrast, no uncertainty interval or significance test; random-02 is unmatched descriptive only

pre_explain_validation.on_any_mismatch: STOP_BEFORE_B5_TEST_EXPLAIN; retain setup/audit evidence and mark INCONCLUSIVE

resource_envelope.monitoring_scope: allocated bytes beneath this unique B5 run directory; immutable data, source install, and shared pre-existing Python 3.12.3/NumPy 2.3.4 environment remain read-only outside the cap

failure_policy.selection_or_order: never change, regenerate, replace, or reorder after freeze
failure_policy.all_archive_or_recomputation_failure: stop before database setup and preserve the failed preflight record
failure_policy.ddl_analyze_or_catalog_failure: retain log/manifest/catalog state; do not run Test EXPLAIN
failure_policy.physical_state_or_mcv_content_mismatch: mark INCONCLUSIVE; do not lower validation criteria or compare Q-errors as matched evidence
failure_policy.incomplete_test_or_diagnostics: preserve every observed/status row and mark INCOMPLETE; do not rerun ALL or add retries automatically
failure_policy.retry: only an identical B5 arm under this frozen protocol after a diagnosed engineering interruption, preserving each attempt separately and within the same caps
